title: Ensure repository creation is limited to specific members
description: Deferred to a later release: a verdict requires reading the global Project Creator permission alongside group membership and per-project create grants, and what counts as sufficiently limited varies by deployment. Reported as MANUAL so the control is not silently dropped.
remediation: Administration -> Global permissions: review who holds "Project Creator" and reduce it to the platform or team leads who need it. Then check Project settings -> Project permissions for each project, since project administrators can create repositories within their own project.
